description: Modify packages/api-core/discovery/ to: (1) emit events on every inter-scenario call via fire-and-forget background goroutine (zero latency impact on caller), (2) load policy cache at scenario startup from vrooli-events, (3) subscribe to SSE policy updates from vrooli-events for real-time cache refresh, (4) enforce sender-side policy checks (fail fast with clear error on denied calls, never makes network call), (5) provide receiver-side middleware that scenarios can plug into their API routers for defense-in-depth policy enforcement. Graceful degradation: if vrooli-events is unreachable, last-known policy holds (configurable fail-open or fail-closed per rule). Must not break any existing inter-scenario communication.
name: discovery-event-emission-and-policy-cache
title: Integrate Event Emission And Policy Caching Into Discovery Package
